data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'idolon', meaning image or statue, Idolla is a name evoking the image of a goddess or protector of a temple. In ancient Greece, idols were believed to house the divine presence and be the intercessors between the gods and humanity. The name Idolla carries the meaning “Goddess of the Temple” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Idolla usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the temple and live with faith, good character and purpose.
